test_title: PYST 81: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the sentences in the correct logical sequence to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

a. This figure is predicted to climb as the percentage of Americans residing in rural areas falls by an average of 1.6% annually.

b. The United Nations reports that India’s urban population is growing at a rate of 1.1 percent annually, while the country's rural population is shrinking at a rate of 0.37 percent annually.

c. While 82% of Americans live in urban settings, only 30% of Indians do so.

d. It's still a considerably smaller percentage of the Indian population than it is in the US that resides in urban areas.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph provides a comparative analysis of the urban and rural population trends in India and the US.
 
• **Sentence B is the first sentence** as it presents the data on India's urban and rural population growth rates:
 
 
• "The United Nations reports that India’s urban population is growing at a rate of 1.1 percent annually, while the country's rural population is shrinking at a rate of 0.37 percent annually."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D follows** as it relates to the comparison mentioned in sentence B:
 
 
• "It's still a considerably smaller percentage of the Indian population than it is in the US that resides in urban areas."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C is the third sentence** because it provides the current percentages of urban populations in the US and India:
 
 
• "While 82% of Americans live in urban settings, only 30% of Indians do so."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A is the fourth** as it discusses the prediction related to the US population:
 
 
• "This figure is predicted to climb as the percentage of Americans residing in rural areas falls by an average of 1.6% annually."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **BDCA**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The United Nations reports that India’s urban population is growing at a rate of 1.1 percent annually, while the country's rural population is shrinking at a rate of 0.37 percent annually. It's still a considerably smaller percentage of the Indian population than it is in the US that resides in urban areas. While 82% of Americans live in urban settings, only 30% of Indians do so. This figure is predicted to climb as the percentage of Americans residing in rural areas falls by an average of 1.6% annually."
